title: Learn Java Programming
description: Master Java programming within a month using our hands-on course. Learn Java syntax, OOP concepts, and prepare for backend development, Android apps, or competitive programming.

Syllabus.title: Introduction and Setup
Syllabus.description: Get started with Java by setting up your development environment and writing your first program.
Lesson: Installing JDK and setting up IDE

Syllabus.title: Variables and Data Types
Syllabus.description: Learn about variables, primitive data types, and how to store data in Java.

Syllabus.title: Operators
Syllabus.description: Understand the operators Java provides for mathematical and logical operations.

Syllabus.title: Control Flow Statements
Syllabus.description: Learn how to control the flow of your Java programs using conditions and loops.

Syllabus.title: Taking User Input
Syllabus.description: Read input from the user using Scanner class in Java.

Syllabus.title: Debugging and Errors
Syllabus.description: Learn how to debug your code and fix common compilation and runtime errors.

Syllabus.title: Arrays
Syllabus.description: Store multiple values in a single variable using arrays.

Syllabus.title: Object-Oriented Programming
Syllabus.description: Understand Java’s core principle of object-oriented design.

Syllabus.title: Encapsulation and Inheritance
Syllabus.description: Write cleaner, reusable, and modular code using OOP principles.

Syllabus.title: Polymorphism and Abstraction
Syllabus.description: Dive deeper into Java OOP using method overloading, overriding, abstract classes, and interfaces.

Syllabus.title: Collections and ArrayList
Syllabus.description: Use advanced data structures for dynamic data handling.

Syllabus.title: Problem Solving with Java
Syllabus.description: Apply everything you’ve learned to solve real-world and algorithmic problems.
Lesson: Solving problems with functions and loops
